d:
Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan was released from Rampur jail after getting bail in the two PAN card case. Soon after his release, the Enforcement Directorate reportedly detained him in connection with a separate case. The ED action is linked to the Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar Trust and Jauhar University.
The agency is investigating alleged financial irregularities and the flow of funds linked to the trust.
Why was Azam Khan detained immediately after his release, and what is the background of the ED case?
